simple.meaning: יִקָּהָה (yiqqâhâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “obedience.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יִקָּהָה (H3349) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:10, with occurrences in Genesis, Proverbs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִקָּהָה (H3349) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יִקָּהָה (H3349) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יִקָּהָה (yiqqâhâh) / H3349 is traced through Genesis 49:10, Proverbs 30:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
